title_zh: 第 4 部分 — 現代加拿大（25 題）
qa: When did Canada join the United Nations?
How many Canadians served in the Korean War?
More than 26,000; 500 died and 1,000 were wounded.
When did Lester Pearson win the Nobel Peace Prize?
Lester Pearson 何時獲諾貝爾和平獎？
For what contribution did Pearson win the prize?
Proposing the UN peacekeeping force during the 1956 Suez Crisis.
1956 年蘇伊士危機時提出聯合國維和部隊。
In what year was the current flag adopted?
In what year was the Official Languages Act passed?
In what year did multiculturalism become official policy?
多元文化哪一年成官方政策？
Who signed the patriated Constitution in 1982?
伊莉莎白二世女王，在渥太華。
The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms.
What was the result of the 1995 Quebec referendum?
About 50.6% voted to stay, 49.4% to separate.
Which prime minister decriminalized homosexuality in 1969?
1969 同性戀除罪化由哪位總理推動？
皮埃爾・艾略特・杜魯道。
Which two Canadian scientists discovered insulin in 1922?
1922 發現胰島素的兩位加拿大科學家？
Sir Frederick Banting and Charles Best.
弗雷德里克・班廷爵士與查爾斯・貝斯特。
Which Scottish-born Canadian invented the telephone?
發明電話的加拿大裔蘇格蘭人？
亞歷山大・格拉漢姆・貝爾。
約瑟夫－阿爾芒・龐巴迪。
Which Canadian invented worldwide standard time zones?
全球時區是哪位加拿大人？
Which Canadian invented basketball, and when?
發明籃球的加拿大人？哪一年？
詹姆斯・奈史密斯；1891 年。
Who were the two founders of BlackBerry?
麥克・拉扎里迪斯與吉姆・巴爾西利。
Who ran the Marathon of Hope after losing a leg to cancer?
帶癌截肢跑「希望馬拉松」的英雄？
In what year did astronaut Chris Hadfield command the International Space Station?
加拿大太空人 Chris Hadfield 哪一年擔任 ISS 指揮官？
Who received an apology in 1988, and from which prime minister?
日裔加拿大人；布萊恩・穆隆尼。
Who received an apology in 2006, and from which prime minister?
Chinese Canadians for the Head Tax; Stephen Harper.
華工人頭稅；史蒂芬・哈珀。
Who received an apology in 2008, and from which prime minister?
寄宿學校原住民；史蒂芬・哈珀。
In what year was the CBC founded?
What were the 1989 Canada-U.S. agreement, the 1994 three-way agreement, and the 2020 replacement called?
1989 加美自由貿易協定？1994 三方？2020 取代後叫？
The Canada-U.S. Free Trade Agreement; NAFTA; USMCA / CUSMA.

title_zh: 第 5 部分 — 政府、選舉、司法（35 題）
qa: What are the three key words describing Canada's system of government?
加拿大政體三個關鍵詞？
Constitutional monarchy, parliamentary democracy, federal state.
君主立憲、議會民主、聯邦國家。
What are the three levels of government?
Federal, provincial or territorial, and municipal.
Is health care a federal or a provincial responsibility?
Shared, but led federally — the guide lists immigration as a shared jurisdiction.
聯邦為主，指南列為聯邦與省共同管轄。
What are the three parts of Parliament?
The Sovereign, the Senate and the House of Commons.
Who represents the Sovereign in Canada?
在加拿大代表君主的職位？
Who is the current Governor General, and why is that historic?
Mary Simon; the first Indigenous Governor General (since 2021).
瑪麗・西蒙；首位原住民總督（2021 年起）。
How are senators chosen, and until what age do they serve?
參議員如何產生？任期至幾歲？
Appointed by the Governor General on the advice of the Prime Minister; they serve until age 75.
由總督依總理建議任命；任職至 75 歲。
How many seats are in the House of Commons, and what is the maximum term?
眾議院多少席？任期最多幾年？
The 2021 guide says 308; seats grow with the population (check elections.ca). Maximum term four years.
2021 年版指南寫 308 席；席次隨人口增加（查 elections.ca）。任期最多 4 年。
What is the abbreviation for a member of the House of Commons?
What are the seven stages of a bill becoming law?
First Reading, Second Reading, Committee Stage, Report Stage, Third Reading, Senate, Royal Assent.
一讀、二讀、委員會、報告、三讀、參議院、御准。
The Governor General, on behalf of the Sovereign.
How does someone become Prime Minister?
The leader of the party with the most seats in the House of Commons is invited by the Governor General to form the government.
眾議院席次最多政黨的黨魁，由總督邀請組閣。
In which chamber are money bills introduced?
What is the name of the federal election agency?
How many electoral districts are there?
The 2021 guide says 308; the number rises with population — check elections.ca before the test.
2021 年版指南寫 308；隨人口增加——考前查 elections.ca。
What electoral system does Canada use?
First-past-the-post — the candidate with the most votes wins the riding.
單一選區相對多數決——得票最多者當選。
What is the difference between a majority and a minority government?
多數政府 vs 少數政府差別？
A majority holds at least half the seats; a minority holds fewer and must seek support from other parties.
多數政府席次過半；少數政府未過半，須與其他黨合作。
What are the five major political parties?
Liberal, Conservative, NDP, Bloc Québécois, Green.
自由黨、保守黨、新民主黨、魁北克集團、綠黨。
Which party runs candidates only in Quebec?
只在 Quebec 競選的黨？
What is the role of the Leader of the Official Opposition?
To hold the government accountable — peacefully oppose or improve government proposals.
讓政府向人民負責——和平反對或改善政府提案。
Opposition members assigned to critique each government department.
反對黨對應每個部會的批評者組成。
What is the voter information card?
A card from Elections Canada confirming you are on the voters' list and stating when and where to vote.
加拿大選舉局寄的卡，確認你在選民名冊上並載明投票時間地點。
What are the three levels of police?
Which provinces have their own provincial police?
Ontario and Quebec (Newfoundland and Labrador also has the Royal Newfoundland Constabulary in some areas).
安大略與魁北克（紐芬蘭與拉布拉多部分地區有皇家紐芬蘭警隊）。
How many Supreme Court judges are there, and who appoints them?
最高法院法官人數？由誰任命？
Nine, appointed by the Governor General on the advice of the federal government.
9 位，由總督依聯邦政府建議任命。
How many people sit on a jury?
What are the core principles of the justice system?
Presumption of innocence, due process, the rule of law and independent courts.
無罪推定、正當程序、法治、獨立司法。
What is the English term for 無罪推定?
加拿大重大刑案無罪推定的英文？
Which section of the Charter guarantees equality before the law?
Equality before the law 哪一條保障？
What is the abbreviation for an Ontario provincial legislator?
MPP — Member of the Provincial Parliament.
What is Quebec's provincial legislature called?

title_en: Chapter 6 — Symbols, Holidays, Money, Economy, Geography, Ontario (70)
title_zh: 第 6 部分 — 象徵、節日、貨幣、經濟、地理、Ontario（70 題）
qa: What is the national motto in Latin and in Chinese?
A Mari Usque Ad Mare — from sea to sea.
A Mari Usque Ad Mare——從海到海。
What is the national anthem, who composed it, and when?
《噢！加拿大》；卡利薩・拉瓦利；1880 年。
When did O Canada officially become the national anthem?
國歌哪一年正式為加拿大國歌？
What are Canada's official winter and summer sports?
加拿大冬／夏兩官方國民運動？
5 月 25 日之前的星期一。
When is Remembrance Day, and what do people wear?
Remembrance Day 是哪天？佩戴什麼？
Which poem is the poppy tradition from, and who wrote it?
Remembrance 罌粟花典故出自哪首詩？作者？
In Flanders Fields, by John McCrae.
〈在法蘭德斯戰場〉，約翰・麥克雷。
When is Truth and Reconciliation Day, and what does it commemorate?
Truth and Reconciliation Day 是哪天？紀念什麼？
September 30; the victims and survivors of residential schools.
9 月 30 日；紀念寄宿學校受害者。
What is Canada's highest civilian honour?
What is the highest military honour?
威爾弗里德・勞里埃爵士。
Who is on the $10 bill, and why is it significant?
Viola Desmond, a black civil rights pioneer (since 2018).
薇奧拉・戴斯蒙，黑人民權英雄（2018 年起）。
Queen Elizabeth II (to be replaced by King Charles III).
伊莉莎白二世女王（即將換成查理三世）。
威廉・萊昂・麥肯齊・金。
What is a loonie worth, and what animal is on it?
Name at least four international organizations Canada belongs to.
加拿大屬於哪些國際組織（至少 4 個）？
UN, NATO, G7, G20, OECD, APEC, the Commonwealth, La Francophonie.
聯合國、北約、G7、G20、OECD、APEC、大英國協、法語國家組織。
What are the three main types of industries?
服務業、製造業、自然資源。
What share of workers are in service industries?
Who is Canada's largest trading partner?
What were the 1989 and 2020 trade agreements?
The Canada-U.S. Free Trade Agreement (1989) and USMCA / CUSMA (2020).
The trade agreement between Canada and the European Union.
加拿大與歐盟的貿易協定。
The Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership.
跨太平洋夥伴全面進步協定。
What are the main crops of the Prairie provinces?
Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Newfoundland and Labrador.
亞伯達、薩克其萬、紐芬蘭與拉布拉多。
In which city is the TSX?
What is the TSX in full?
How large is Canada among the world's countries?
What is the capital of Canada, and in which province?
Atlantic, Central, Prairie, West Coast and Northern.
大西洋、中部、草原、西海岸、北方。
Which four provinces are the Atlantic Provinces?
Newfoundland and Labrador, PEI, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick.
紐芬蘭與拉布拉多、愛德華王子島、新斯科細亞、新布藍瑞克。
Which two provinces are Central Canada?
Which three provinces are the Prairies?
曼尼托巴、薩克其萬、亞伯達。
Which province is the West Coast?
What are the three northern territories?
育空、西北地區、努納福特。
What is the capital of Newfoundland and Labrador?
What is the capital of PEI?
What is the capital of Nova Scotia?
What is the capital of New Brunswick, and what is special about the province?
New Brunswick 首府？特殊地位？
Fredericton; the only officially bilingual province.
弗雷德里克頓；唯一官方雙語省。
What is the capital of Quebec?
What is the capital of Ontario?
What is the capital of Manitoba?
What is the capital of Saskatchewan, and which police force is headquartered there?
Saskatchewan 首府？哪間警隊總部？
里賈納；皇家騎警訓練學院。
What is the capital of Alberta, and which two national parks are there?
Alberta 首府？哪兩個國家公園？
艾德蒙頓；班夫與賈斯珀。
What is the capital of BC, and which city hosted the 2010 Winter Olympics?
BC 首府？2010 冬奧城市？
What is the capital of Yukon?
What is the capital of the Northwest Territories?
When was Nunavut created, and what is its capital?
What is Canada's highest mountain, and where?
Which of the five Great Lakes lies entirely in the United States?
五大湖 4 個共享 1 個全在美國，哪一個？
Who is Ontario's current Premier, and which party?
Doug Ford; Progressive Conservative (confirm on ontario.ca before the test).
道格・福特；進步保守黨（考前到 ontario.ca 確認）。
Who is Ontario's current Lieutenant Governor, and why is it historic?
Ontario 現任 Lt. Governor？歷史意義？
Edith Dumont; the first Franco-Ontarian in the role.
伊迪絲・杜蒙；首位法裔安大略人。
What is the abbreviation for an Ontario provincial legislator?
What are three main industries of Ontario?
Toronto 是加拿大第幾大城市？
Niagara Falls lies between which two lakes?
Niagara Falls 位於哪兩湖之間？
Where are Mississauga and Brampton in the Greater Toronto Area?
Mississauga 與 Brampton 在大 Toronto 哪一帶？
West of Toronto, in the western GTA.
Which American city faces Windsor across the river?
Windsor 對岸是美國哪個城市？
